question.question: Please deduce the distribution of the cards.
options: A) K at 1, 6, 8; Q at 4; J at 2, 5, 7; A at 3
B) K at 1, 3, 8; Q at 5; J at 2, 6, 7; A at 4
C) K at 2, 5, 7; Q at 4; J at 1, 6, 8; A at 3
D) K at 1, 6, 8; Q at 3; J at 2, 5, 7; A at 4
